notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}.
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, targeting Palinchron.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving the nontoken Palinchron +2/+2 until end of turn and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.
